title: Warranty Coverage Transfer Request Timing Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** For a Warranty Coverage transfer request, calendar days are counted from the day after the home sale closing date on the transfer request to the confirmation date.

| Days after the home sale closing date | Timing treatment |
|---|---|
| no more than 10 | the plan's transfer fee at the prompt-request rate of 0.8 (80 percent of the fee) |
| 11 to 30 | no timing rate or handling charge |
| more than 30 | the plan's transfer fee plus the late-request handling charge of 25.00 |

In clause form: a request confirmed no more than the prompt-request window of 10 days after the closing date takes the prompt-request rate on the plan's transfer fee; a request confirmed more than the late-request threshold of 30 days after the closing date carries the plan's transfer fee plus the late-request handling charge; any other request carries no timing rate or handling charge.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical closing date 1 June)

| Confirmation date | Days counted | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| 11 June | 10 | prompt-request rate |
| 12 June | 11 | none |
| 1 July | 30 | none |
| 2 July | 31 | late-request handling charge |

## Figures (hypothetical plan transfer fee 80.00)

- Confirmed 10 days after closing: 80 percent of 80.00 is 64.00.
- Confirmed 31 days after closing: 80.00 plus 25.00 is 105.00.

The closing date is the home sale closing date recorded on the transfer request.
